name: fix_kotlin_shared_mutable_copy
description: Fixes a shallow data-class copy() that mutates the original's shared list
prompts: Billing.withDiscount in src/main/kotlin/com/optarena/app/Billing.kt must return a new Invoice with discounted lines while leaving the ORIGINAL invoice untouched - but data-class copy() is shallow, so the copy shares the same MutableList and the in-place loop corrupts the original's lines too. Fix withDiscount so the returned invoice has its own list of discounted values (e.g. build a new list with map and pass it to copy(lines = ...)) and the original is unchanged. Keep the Invoice declaration and both function signatures.
